objective: Independently review and test the strict P0 contract validator and non-executing declared-context policy observer, including malformed input, authority confusion, offline references, error redaction and compatibility.

criterion_checks.basis: Read the parser, profile copier, local-reference traversal, explicit format checker, canonical digest implementation, envelope semantics and promoted schemas. Independently executed the new control suite and reproduced R1/R2 before and after correction. Duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8/surrogates, float/non-finite/unsafe-integer input, bounded depth/nodes/bytes, digest mismatch, UTC timestamp semantics and referenced subschema validity are checked. RFC8785 uses a pinned library and a UTF-16 ordering vector that differs from Python scalar sorting.

Read policy/context schemas and evaluator branches; independently exercised eight invalid lexical paths, exact context comparisons and an explicitly supplied production simulation. Scope/principal/environment/policy/budget/expiry and declared operation/artifact/publication bounds are checked. High risk remains require_review and every observation remains executable=false and authority_verified=false. Local context is declared simulation, not authenticated identity or a grant.

Inspected imports and control flow for action execution, network calls, artifact resolution and raw output. Actual tests cover blocked socket/subprocess calls, no target-file reads or changes, minimal CLI responses and sanitized argument/input errors. Contract validation explicitly reports authenticity=not_verified; signed-looking records and advisory proceed/accepted statements cannot grant execution authority. Only explicit input files and fixed schema assets are read.

Evaluator independently ran 85 new tests successfully. Independently inspected final main-session logs for all 10 modules: 182 unique tests passed, including the 85 new tests. Initial sandbox TEMP and local bare-Git fixture setup failures were retained and resolved through environment-only retries without changing product or test behavior. Findings R1-R3 are resolved and affected areas rechecked.

Read English implementation and Korean usage documentation, pinned dependencies, default policy, CLI semantics and future-work boundaries. Documentation identifies UTC uppercase-Z/microsecond limits, input bounds, optional explicit dependency installation, expired fixtures, non-authoritative allow observations and unchanged result1.0. This review covers the source/documents; final task submission, durable checkpoint and publication remain main-session lifecycle steps.

findings.finding: The pinned environment lacked optional date-time and URI FormatChecker registrations. Schema validation silently skipped required formats. A malformed declared authorization expiry reached datetime.fromisoformat and raised an unbounded ValueError containing the synthetic input value.
findings.reproduction: Set context.authorization.expires_at to a synthetic invalid string ending in Z and evaluate a valid fixture at its fixed clock. Original result was a raw ValueError; FormatChecker listed no date-time or URI checks.
findings.required_remedy: Guarantee offline required format checks and fail closed on unavailable formats; validate all timestamp-bearing envelope fields; sanitize timestamp failures in the observer.
findings.resolution: Explicit date-time/URI/UUID checkers and pinned rfc3339/rfc3986 dependencies replace optional discovery. UTC precision is bounded and documented, unsupported formats fail closed, resolved schema nodes are checked, and observer timestamp failures become safe deny observations. Author regressions and independent reproduction passed.

findings.finding: Root schema meta-validation did not validate a local reference target stored under an arbitrary extension property. An invalid type there raised jsonschema.UnknownType and exposed the instance in its exception text.
findings.reproduction: Use a Draft202012 root with extension={type:not-a-real-type}, $ref=#/extension and synthetic marker data. The original exception lacked a stable code and contained the data.
findings.required_remedy: Traverse and meta-validate every resolved schema target, reject hidden external/dialect/format changes and normalize schema runtime exceptions without a leaking exception chain.
findings.resolution: All actual/resolved subschemas are meta-validated; reference traversal is cycle-aware; UnknownType and UndefinedTypeCheck are normalized; safe errors suppress chained raw exceptions. Independent invalid-type and unsupported-format reproductions now return schema_invalid/schema_format without the marker.

findings.finding: A missing lazily imported dependency was reported as invalid_input, hiding the actionable setup diagnostic promised by the implementation documentation.
findings.reproduction: Mock only the rfc8785 import as missing and validate a valid fixture; original CLI returned invalid_input.
findings.required_remedy: Allowlist dependency-specific errors to a fixed safe dependency code and static installation hint without echoing exceptions or paths.
findings.resolution: CLI maps dependency_missing/dependency_incompatible to dependency_unavailable with a static pinned-requirements hint. A real lazy-import regression was added and passed in the evaluator's 85-test run. No automatic installation is performed.

findings.finding: The integration helper initially hashed LF-normalized command output while stored Windows logs contained CRLF; all14 recorded log digests differed from stored bytes.
findings.required_remedy: Define log hash semantics and hash the actual stored bytes; preserve original failed logs.
findings.resolution: Main session recomputed hashes from stored files and documented byte semantics. Evaluator independently confirmed all14 final log hashes and all18 source hashes now match actual bytes. No source or test change required.
